editorNote: Monday's headlines span a Gemini 4 timing comment at Alphabet, analyst actions on Duolingo and Rocket Lab, an Alibaba cornerstone investment, and range-bound gold and bitcoin ahead of a Fed meeting. Article bodies could not be retrieved, so this edition reports only what the headlines state and offers no view on direction.

stories.headline: Bitcoin rebounds above $82,000 as oil's retreat lifts risk mood, Bloomberg reports
stories.summary: Bloomberg's headline says bitcoin rebounded above $82,000 as a retreat in oil lifted risk sentiment; Yahoo Finance's headline says BTC touched $83,000 but could not hold it. Only headlines were retrievable.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin is trading in the low $80,000s, inside the $80,000–$88,000 range earlier editions described.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $82,000 as Oil’s Retreat Lifts Risk Mood - Bloomberg.com
BTC USD Touched $83,000 With Everything Going Its Way, and Still Could Not Hold It - Yahoo Finance

stories.headline: Google's DeepMind chief says the Gemini 4 launch is coming 'much earlier', Stocktwits reports
stories.summary: Stocktwits's headline says the DeepMind chief indicated Gemini 4 will launch 'much earlier', framing it as an answer to Meta's Muse AI. Only the headline was retrievable.
stories.whyItMatters: The statement concerns the timing of Alphabet's flagship model, which earlier editions noted had been reported as running behind.
